products.product_description: Green Leaf Lettuce is sold in bulk cases under "Garre Farms" or "Rossi Farms" brand. There are 24 heads of green leaf lettuce packed in each cardboard box. The Garre Farms brand is labeled in parts: "***OREGON'S OWN!***Fresh Produce***GARRE FARMS, LLC***PORTLAND, OR 97230***PRODUCE OF U.S.A***". The Rossi Farms brand is labeled as "***ROSSI FARMS***3701 N.E. 122nd AVE PORTLAND, OR 97230*** PRODUCE OF U.S.A.***".
products.product_quantity: 498 cases/24 heads of lettuce per case
products.code_info: NONE. No best by dates, no expiration dates, no lot codes.
products.reason_for_recall: Garre Farms is recalling green leaf lettuce due to a potential contamination with Listeria monocytogenes.
